title: Fresh-seed review (55, 56; t=32) of c39's long crawler runs: on both seeds layered cells form from the random field and one layered half-moon crawler travels 3.2 and 4.2 of its own diameters merger-free; the crawler is box-scale (diameter ~0.6 of the box) and is assembled by absorbing the other cells
summary: Re-ran the claimed world unchanged (labkit, 160 frames, t=32, 256^2) on seeds 55 and 56 and applied the claim's own crawlpath.py and sdlayer.py to my frames. Both start from the random two-phase field and give 6-9 round cells with s rings by t~1.4; polarized cells merge with and absorb the static ones until one half-moon crawler remains (components final 1). crawlpath.py: seed 55 track 29 (frames 60-160, diameter 161 px) net 3.19 own diameters, path 3.21; seed 56 track 37 (frames 30-160, diameter 155 px) net 4.18, path 4.22; both born by merge, no merge or split after. sdlayer.py (signed distance): s layer on 98% (seed 55, 48 body-frames) and 100% (seed 56, 37 body-frames) of body-frames from t=8, median rim/out 19.7 and 21.6, rim/core 3.5 on seed 56. labkit's centroid-radial screen does not flag s on the crawler tracks (rim/core 1.4-2.0 aggregate), as expected for a non-round body. A shorter t=16 run on seeds 53/54 (my review 20261026T1745-c45-review-crawlers of the parent claim) gave no crawler on seed 53 (polarized cells died) and 1.5 sqrt(area) lengths on seed 54.

observations.S: rerun/seed55/sheet.png, rerun/seed56/sheet.png t=0: random two-phase field over the whole box
observations.I: rerun/seed56/sheet.png t=8-32: one crawler with constant body plan, area ratio 1.10 over its track (FACTS.md)
observations.B: sdlayer.txt: s rim band on 98% / 100% of body-frames from t=8, median rim/out 19.7 / 21.6; source kp*phi*rho is the cell's own polarity protein
observations.M: crawlpath.txt: seed 55 track 29 net 3.19 own diameters (path 3.21), seed 56 track 37 net 4.18 (path 4.22), merger-free, half-moon shape kept (sheet t=11-32)

verdicts.limitation: The crawler that passes is box-scale: diameter 155-161 px in a 256 px periodic box, built by absorbing every other cell, so the run ends with one individual and its motion is net displacement across the periodic box. At t=16 (shorter runs on seeds 53, 54) M is not reached and on seed 53 no crawler survives. I did not re-run the KIN=1 or SRC=none controls. A box-size check (does the crawler's size scale with the box?) is untested.
